-- ============================================================
-- JOB MARKET INTELLIGENCE
-- Synapse Serverless SQL
-- Skrypt: sql_check_gold_snapshots
-- ============================================================


-- KROK 1. UTWORZENIE BAZY DANYCH
-- Wykonane jednorazowo w bazie master.
-- Baza job_market już istnieje.

-- CREATE DATABASE job_market;


-- ============================================================
-- KROK 2. UTWORZENIE WIDOKU GOLD
-- Wykonane jednorazowo w bazie job_market.
-- Widok odczytuje pliki Parquet z Azure Data Lake.
-- Gwiazdka (*) obejmuje również przyszłe snapshoty.
-- ============================================================

-- CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_job_snapshots
-- AS
-- SELECT
--     REPLACE(jobs.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
--     jobs.*
-- FROM OPENROWSET(
--     BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/fact_job_snapshots/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
--     FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
-- ) AS jobs;


-- ============================================================
-- KROK 3. KONTROLA DANYCH GOLD
-- Aktywne zapytanie.
-- Zwraca liczbę ofert dla każdego dnia.
-- ============================================================

-- SELECT
--     snapshot_date,
--     COUNT(*) AS liczba_ofert
-- FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots
-- GROUP BY snapshot_date
-- ORDER BY snapshot_date;


-- ============================================================
-- krok — kontrola duplikatów z danego dnia 
-- SELECT
--     snapshot_date,
--     COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
--     COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) AS unique_jobs,
--     COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) AS duplicate_rows
-- FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots
-- GROUP BY snapshot_date
-- ORDER BY snapshot_date;
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- analiza powtarzających się ofert dla calej bazy
-- SELECT
--     COUNT(*) AS unique_jobs,
--     SUM(appearances) AS total_observations,
--     SUM(appearances - 1) AS repeated_observations,
--     SUM(CASE WHEN appearances > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
--         AS jobs_seen_multiple_days,
--     MAX(appearances) AS max_days_observed
-- FROM (
--     SELECT
--         job_id,
--         COUNT(*) AS appearances
--     FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots
--     GROUP BY job_id
-- ) AS offer_history;
-- -- ============================================================


-- ============================================================
-- KROK 4. KONFIGURACJA DOSTĘPU POWER BI DO SYNAPSE SERVERLESS
-- ============================================================
--
-- Cel:
-- Umożliwienie Power BI Desktop bezpiecznego odczytu danych
-- analitycznych z bazy job_market przez Microsoft Entra ID.
--
-- Architektura dostępu:
-- Power BI Desktop
--     -> Microsoft Entra ID (uwierzytelnianie)
--     -> Synapse Serverless SQL (autoryzacja)
--     -> dbo.vw_job_snapshots
--     -> ADLS Gen2 / Gold (Parquet)
--
-- Bezpieczeństwo:
-- 1. Wykorzystujemy dedykowane konto powerbi-reader.
-- 2. Nie używamy loginu administratora SQL.
-- 3. Stosujemy zasadę Least Privilege.
-- 4. Użytkownik otrzymuje SELECT wyłącznie do wskazanego widoku.
-- 5. Nie nadajemy uprawnień do modyfikacji danych.
--
-- Wymagania:
-- - Konto musi istnieć w Microsoft Entra ID.
-- - Polecenia wykonujemy w bazie job_market.
-- - Wykorzystujemy pulę Synapse Serverless SQL (Built-in).
-- - Dostęp do plików Gold musi być prawidłowo skonfigurowany
--   dla kontekstu bezpieczeństwa używanego przez widok.
--
-- Uwaga:
-- CREATE USER wykonujemy jednorazowo.
-- Ponowne wykonanie wymaga sprawdzenia, czy użytkownik
-- już istnieje w bazie danych.
--
-- ============================================================

-- CREATE USER [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com]
-- FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER;

-- GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_snapshots
-- TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];

-- SELECT TOP 30
--     job_snapshot_key,
--     job_id,
--     skill_index,
--     skill_name,
--     skill_level
-- FROM OPENROWSET(
--     BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
--     FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
-- ) AS skills
-- ORDER BY job_snapshot_key, skill_index;

-- SELECT TOP 20
--     job_snapshot_key,
--     skill_index,
--     COUNT(*) AS occurrences
-- FROM OPENROWSET(
--     BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
--     FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
-- ) AS skills
-- GROUP BY job_snapshot_key, skill_index
-- HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
-- ORDER BY occurrences DESC;

-- SELECT
--     COUNT(DISTINCT skill_name) AS unique_skills,
--     COUNT(*) AS total_assignments
-- FROM OPENROWSET(
--     BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
--     FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
-- ) AS skills;

-- SELECT TOP 20
--     skill_name,
--     COUNT(*) AS occurrences
-- FROM OPENROWSET(
--     BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
--     FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
-- ) AS skills
-- GROUP BY skill_name
-- ORDER BY occurrences DESC;

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

We are looking for an Expert QA Engineer to step into a leadership role within our Data Enablement Team. In this position, you will be the driving force behind performance engineering with a strong emphasis on automation.

As a QA Lead, you will direct software development teams, define comprehensive testing strategies, and ensure the highest product reliability before release. You will work in a dynamic Agile (SAFe) environment, driving the implementation of modern automation tools and best practices to optimize overall testing efficiency.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  • Testing Strategy & Leadership: Defining test strategies, planning, and executing testing phases while identifying areas for process improvement.
  • Hands-on Automation: Designing and implementing robust test automation scripts and day-to-day automated solutions using Python and Robot Framework.
  • Requirement Analysis: Proactively analyzing and challenging project requirements when they lack clarity to ensure optimal delivery.
  • Test Management: Preparing test scenarios, managing test data, analyzing execution results, and reporting defects.
  • CI/CD Integration: Executing automated regression testing seamlessly through continuous integration pipelines.


Kogo poszukujemy?

Must-Have Technical Experience:
  • Python: 7+ years of hands-on development/automation experience.
  • Database Technologies: 7+ years of deep experience, including the confidence to write complex SQL queries.
  • Robot Framework: 4+ years of practical experience.
  • CI/CD & Version Control: 4+ years of experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins) and 5+ years with Git.
Essential Skills & Tools:
  • Strong working proficiency with Linux and Bash scripting.
  • Proven experience with test management tools (qTest, Zephyr) and collaboration suites (Jira, Bitbucket, Jenkins/Bamboo).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Developers, Analysts, Product Owners, and Scrum Masters.
Familiarity with Data & Cloud Ecosystems:
  • Understanding of distributed data processing engines like Spark.
  • Knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem (Hive, Oozie, MapReduce, etc.).
  • Basic knowledge of AWS architectural components (Lambda, Step Functions, State Machines, etc.).
Nice-to-have (Bonus points):
  • Experience with containerization using Docker.
  • Knowledge of streaming and message queue technologies (e.g., KAFKA, IBM MQ).
  • Prior exposure to Scala/Spark.

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

gold_base = f"abfss://gold@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/fact_job_snapshots/"

    success_path = Path(output_path + "_SUCCESS")

    # Idempotencja: kompletny dzień pomijamy bez odczytywania Parquet.
    if gold_fs.exists(success_path):
        print(f"{snapshot_date}: Gold istnieje (_SUCCESS) — pomijam.")
        skipped_dates.append(snapshot_date)

    # Nie nadpisujemy nawet częściowo utworzonego katalogu.

        F.col("salary.period").alias("salary_period"),
        F.col("run_id"),
    )

    # Walidujemy PRZED deduplikacją i PRZED zapisem.
    invalid_ids = gold_jobs.filter(
        F.col("job_id").isNull()
        | (F.trim(F.col("job_id").cast("string")) == "")
    ).limit(1).count()
    duplicate_ids = (
        gold_jobs.groupBy("job_id")

        .filter(F.col("count") > 1)

    if row_count == 0 or invalid_ids or duplicate_ids:
        raise RuntimeError(

            f"(rows={row_count}, invalid_ids={invalid_ids}, "

        )

    # snapshot_date jest w nazwie partycji; Spark odtworzy ją przy

    (
        gold_jobs.drop("snapshot_date")
        .write
        .mode("errorifexists")
        .parquet(output_path)
    )
    written_dates.append(snapshot_date)
    print(f"{snapshot_date}: DATA QUALITY PASSED; zapisano {row_count} rekordów.")

# 1. KONFIGURACJA — Gold v2 (Gold v1 pozostaje bez zmian)
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

account = "stjobmarketdev01"
silver_base = f"abfss://silver@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/source=solidjobs/"
gold_root = f"abfss://gold@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/v2/"
gold_v1_base = f"abfss://gold@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/fact_job_snapshots/"

Path = spark._jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path
hadoop_conf = spark._jsc.hadoopConfiguration()
silver_fs = Path(silver_base).getFileSystem(hadoop_conf)
gold_fs = Path(gold_root).getFileSystem(hadoop_conf)

TABLES = ("fact_job_snapshots", "bridge_job_skills", "bridge_job_locations")
print("SILVER:", silver_base)
print("GOLD V2:", gold_root)

# 3. TRANSFORMACJA + WALIDACJA + PUBLIKACJA TRZECH TABEL
# Jedynym sygnałem kompletnego dnia jest _SUCCESS w katalogu _manifest.
written_dates = []
skipped_dates = []

for snapshot_date, snapshot_path in selected_snapshots:
    paths = {
        name: gold_root + f"{name}/snapshot_date={snapshot_date}/"
        for name in TABLES
    }
    manifest_path = gold_root + f"_manifest/snapshot_date={snapshot_date}/"
    manifest_success = Path(manifest_path + "_SUCCESS")

    if gold_fs.exists(manifest_success):
        if not all(gold_fs.exists(Path(path + "_SUCCESS")) for path in paths.values()):
            raise RuntimeError(f"{snapshot_date}: manifest istnieje, ale jedna z tabel jest niekompletna")
        print(f"{snapshot_date}: Gold v2 ukończony — pomijam")
        skipped_dates.append(snapshot_date)
        continue

    # Bez nadpisywania! Jeśli zapis wcześniej się nie powiódł, wymagamy diagnostyki.
    existing = [name for name, path in paths.items() if gold_fs.exists(Path(path))]
    if existing or gold_fs.exists(Path(manifest_path)):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{snapshot_date}: częściowy Gold v2 ({existing}), brak manifestu. Nie nadpisuję!")

    daily_jobs = spark.read.parquet(snapshot_path)
    run_id = snapshot_path.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1].removeprefix("run_id=")
    key = F.concat_ws("|", F.lit("solidjobs"), F.lit(snapshot_date), F.col("jobOfferKey"))

    gold_jobs = daily_jobs.select(
        key.alias("job_snapshot_key"),
        F.lit("solidjobs").alias("source"),
        F.col("jobOfferKey").alias("job_id"),
        F.col("run_id"),
        "title", "division", "category",
        F.col("subCategory").alias("sub_category"),
        "company",
        F.col("companyLogoUrl").alias("company_logo_url"),
        F.col("experienceLevel").alias("experience_level"),
        F.col("salary.from").alias("salary_from"),
        F.col("salary.to").alias("salary_to"),
        F.col("salary.currency").alias("salary_currency"),
        F.col("salary.period").alias("salary_period"),
        F.col("salary.employmentType").alias("employment_type"),
        F.col("isRemote").alias("is_remote"),
        F.col("isHybrid").alias("is_hybrid"),
        F.col("contractTime").alias("contract_time"),
        F.col("validFrom").alias("valid_from"),
        F.col("validTo").alias("valid_to"),
        F.col("updatedAt").alias("updated_at"),
        "url",
        F.to_json("languages").alias("languages_json"),
        F.to_json("benefits").alias("benefits_json"),
    )

    gold_skills = (
        daily_jobs.select(
            key.alias("job_snapshot_key"),
            F.col("jobOfferKey").alias("job_id"),
            F.col("run_id"),
            F.posexplode_outer("skills").alias("skill_index", "skill"),
        )
        .filter(F.col("skill").isNotNull())
        .select("job_snapshot_key", "job_id", "run_id", "skill_index",
                F.col("skill.name").alias("skill_name"),
                F.col("skill.level").alias("skill_level"))
    )

    gold_locations = (
        daily_jobs.select(
            key.alias("job_snapshot_key"),
            F.col("jobOfferKey").alias("job_id"),
            F.col("run_id"),
            F.posexplode_outer("locations").alias("location_index", "location"),
        )
        .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
        .select("job_snapshot_key", "job_id", "run_id", "location_index",
                F.trim(F.col("location")).alias("location_name"))
    )

    # Walidujemy przed pierwszym zapisem.
    job_count = gold_jobs.count()
    bad_ids = gold_jobs.filter(
        F.col("job_id").isNull() | (F.trim(F.col("job_id").cast("string")) == "")
    ).limit(1).count()
    duplicate_jobs = gold_jobs.groupBy("job_snapshot_key").count().filter("count > 1").limit(1).count()
    wrong_runs = daily_jobs.filter(
        F.col("run_id").isNull() | (F.col("run_id") != F.lit(run_id))
    ).limit(1).count()
    if not job_count or bad_ids or duplicate_jobs or wrong_runs:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{snapshot_date}: niepoprawna tabela faktów "
            f"(rows={job_count}, bad_ids={bad_ids}, duplicates={duplicate_jobs}, wrong_runs={wrong_runs})"
        )

    expected_skills = daily_jobs.select(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("skills").isNull(), F.lit(0)).otherwise(F.size("skills"))).alias("n")
    ).first()["n"] or 0
    expected_locations = daily_jobs.select(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("locations").isNull(), F.lit(0)).otherwise(F.size("locations"))).alias("n")
    ).first()["n"] or 0
    skill_count = gold_skills.count()
    location_count = gold_locations.count()
    if (skill_count != expected_skills or location_count != expected_locations):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{snapshot_date}: utracone elementy tablic: "
            f"skills={skill_count}/{expected_skills}, locations={location_count}/{expected_locations}"
        )

    parent_keys = gold_jobs.select("job_snapshot_key")
    for name, child, index_col in (
        ("skills", gold_skills, "skill_index"),
        ("locations", gold_locations, "location_index"),
    ):
        orphan = child.join(parent_keys, "job_snapshot_key", "left_anti").limit(1).count()
        bad_index = child.filter(F.col(index_col).isNull()).limit(1).count()
        duplicated = child.groupBy("job_snapshot_key", index_col).count().filter("count > 1").limit(1).count()
        if orphan or bad_index or duplicated:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{snapshot_date}: {name} failed "
                f"(orphans={orphan}, bad_index={bad_index}, duplicates={duplicated})"
            )

    # Trzy tabele w jednym uruchomieniu sesji Spark; zapis append-only.
    for table_name, frame in (
        ("fact_job_snapshots", gold_jobs),
        ("bridge_job_skills", gold_skills),
        ("bridge_job_locations", gold_locations),
    ):
        frame.write.mode("errorifexists").parquet(paths[table_name])
        if not gold_fs.exists(Path(paths[table_name] + "_SUCCESS")):
            raise RuntimeError(f"{snapshot_date}: brak _SUCCESS: {table_name}")

    # Manifest publikujemy dopiero PO poprawnym zapisie wszystkich trzech tabel.
    manifest = spark.createDataFrame(
        [(snapshot_date, run_id, job_count, skill_count, location_count)],
        "snapshot_date string, run_id string, job_count long, skill_count long, location_count long",
    )
    manifest.write.mode("errorifexists").parquet(manifest_path)
    if not gold_fs.exists(manifest_success):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{snapshot_date}: brak _SUCCESS manifestu")

    written_dates.append(snapshot_date)
    print(f"{snapshot_date}: GOLD V2 COMMITTED: jobs={job_count}, skills={skill_count}, locations={location_count}")

# 4. PODSUMOWANIE
print("====================================")
print("GOLD V2 — 3 TABELE + MANIFEST")
print("Zapisane dni:", written_dates)
print("Pominięte dni:", skipped_dates)
print("GOLD ROOT:", gold_root)
print("Gotowe; Gold v1 nie został zmieniony.")

-- ============================================================
-- JOB MARKET INTELLIGENCE | GOLD V2
-- Synapse Serverless SQL (Built-in) | baza: job_market
-- Nie zmienia Gold v1 ani dbo.vw_job_snapshots.
-- ============================================================

-- Uruchom w Synapse Studio z kontekstem bazy job_market.
-- Skrypt korzysta z uprawnien Microsoft Entra / ADLS aktualnego uzytkownika.

-- ============================================================
-- 1. WIDOKI GOLD V2 (3 tabele biznesowe)
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(jobs.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    jobs.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/fact_job_snapshots/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS jobs;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_skills_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(skills.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    skills.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS skills;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_locations_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(locations.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    locations.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_locations/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS locations;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 2. WIDOK MANIFESTU (kontrola zakonczonych dni)
--    Nie jest czwarta tabela biznesowa; to metadane ETL.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS
SELECT
    manifest.snapshot_date,
    manifest.run_id,
    manifest.job_count,
    manifest.skill_count,
    manifest.location_count
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/_manifest/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS manifest;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 3. RAPORT KONTROLNY: liczby i manifest dla kazdego dnia
-- ============================================================

WITH fact_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS fact_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS skill_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
),
location_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS location_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
)
SELECT
    m.snapshot_date,
    m.run_id,
    m.job_count AS expected_jobs,
    f.fact_rows,
    m.skill_count AS expected_skills,
    s.skill_rows,
    m.location_count AS expected_locations,
    l.location_rows,
    CASE WHEN m.job_count = f.fact_rows
           AND m.skill_count = s.skill_rows
           AND m.location_count = l.location_rows
         THEN 'OK' ELSE 'CHECK' END AS count_status
FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
LEFT JOIN fact_counts AS f ON f.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN skill_counts AS s ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN location_counts AS l ON l.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
ORDER BY m.snapshot_date;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 4. SPRAWDZENIE DUPLIKATOW (wynik pusty = brak duplikatow)
-- ============================================================

SELECT 'fact' AS dataset, job_snapshot_key, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_index, COUNT_BIG(*) AS occurrences
FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'skills', job_snapshot_key, CAST(skill_index AS BIGINT), COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key, skill_index
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'locations', job_snapshot_key, CAST(location_index AS BIGINT), COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key, location_index
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 5. SKILLS: TOP 20 (wszystkie dni / wystapienia, nie unikalne oferty)
-- ============================================================

SELECT TOP 20 skill_name, COUNT_BIG(*) AS occurrences
FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
GROUP BY skill_name
ORDER BY occurrences DESC;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 6. POWER BI: GRANT SELECT DLA ISTNIEJACEGO UZYTKOWNIKA
--    Uruchom po utworzeniu widokow, w bazie job_market.
--    Brak CREATE USER: uzytkownik zostal juz utworzony.
-- ============================================================

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];
GO

-- UWAGA: powyzsze widoki czytaja wszystkie dostepne partycje Parquet.
-- Manifest sluzy do weryfikacji, ale same widoki nie filtruja
-- automatycznie niekompletnych dni. Zanim udostepnisz nowe daty
-- Power BI, wymagaj poprawnego manifestu dla tych dat.
